summary: E2E testing of the new ONLINE CHECK-IN feature on preview. All backend endpoints (info/document/submit), all FE validations (empty fields, missing photo, missing consent), full success flow, re-open after completion, invalid-token error page, and booking-status-checker integration (link visible for confirmed, 'completato' for completed) PASS. Backend regression suite 19/19 green. One blocking BUG FOUND and FIXED (in Fix Scope): checkin/submit returned 500 because request.base_url is http:// behind the preview proxy and the email guard rejects non-https links. Added https coercion in /checkin/{id}/submit before building email HTML.

minor.issue: request.base_url is 'http://...' in preview (behind TLS-terminating proxy); the Emergent email guard raises ValueError on non-https links, causing 500. Fixed by coercing http -> https on base URL. Same pattern exists in webhook/_mark_paid flows; those use origin_url (always https) so they work, but any future use of request.base_url should go through a helper. Consider adding _force_https() util or trusting X-Forwarded-Proto.

backend.Owner email: Log line 'Owner checkin email id: 01a1077d-...' present after submit

frontend_e2e.Empty submit toast: Completa tutti i campi obbligatori di ogni ospite
frontend_e2e.Submit without photo (all fields filled): Carica la foto del documento del capogruppo (Ospite 1)
frontend_e2e.Submit without consent (photo present): Devi autorizzare il trattamento dei dati per proseguire
frontend_e2e.booking-status-checker (confirmed, not d: status-checkin-link visible, href contains checkin= and token=
frontend_e2e.booking-status-checker (completed): shows 'Check-in online già completato', no status-checkin-link

verification_details.i18n: 4 'checkin:' blocks present in /app/frontend/src/i18n.js (it/en/de/es) including successTitle, alreadyTitle, errorPhoto, errorConsent for each locale.

action_items: OPTIONAL (not blocking): factor a _force_https(base_url) helper (or honor X-Forwarded-Proto via Uvicorn --proxy-headers) so request.base_url is always https. Current fix in checkin/submit is a targeted string replace.

OPTIONAL (minor UX): the 'birth_province' and 'doc_issued_by' inputs have no data-testid (only placeholder); fine for now, consider adding guest-{i}-birth-province / guest-{i}-doc-issued-by for stability.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckInPage.jsx uploads one document at a time serially (OK, max 8 small blobs). It triggers compressImage on main thread; fine but consider a loading hint while uploading.

Submit flow performs document POST BEFORE submit POST but relies on the submit endpoint to re-check doc existence. If network interrupts between upload success and submit, the orphan doc stays. Low priority (upsert-based, no PII leak).
Server stores raw binary documents in MongoDB via motor (as expected per app design). No AV/mime enforcement besides content_type starts with image/*; max 8MB enforced server-side. Good.
status endpoint correctly only exposes checkin_booking_id/checkin_token when status in ('paid','confirmed') and action_token present.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The http->https coercion in /checkin/{id}/submit is required for the preview environment. If running on Render in production, the proxy sets X-Forwarded-Proto=https and uvicorn with --proxy-headers would already make request.base_url https — so the coercion is a harmless safety net. All DB test data was cleaned at the end of this run.
rca of the issue: RCA: POST /api/checkin/{id}/submit returned 500 in preview. Backend builds owner-notification email HTML with doc links using str(request.base_url). In the Emergent preview, FastAPI/Uvicorn is not launched with --proxy-headers so request.base_url returns 'http://book-assisi-direct.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud/'. The emergentintegrations email client validates all links/assets must be absolute https (guard G3) and raises ValueError. The exception bubbles up before any HTTP response is returned, hence 500. Fix: force https on base before string-formatting into email HTML (minimal, targeted). Verified: subsequent submit returned 200, owner-email id logged, info/completed=true, document download returns image/jpeg.
